A transgender cult was linked to eight extremely brutal murders, and yet the media has been silent about it. Something this bizarre seems like fiction, but the Zizians were a real sick and twisted cult. Andy Ngo, New York Times best-selling author, just published The Zizians: Inside a Trans Death Cult, and he joins me to talk about why this story has been mainstream media’s kryptonite.

Sara Gonzales is the host of Sara Gonzales Unfiltered, a daily news program on Blaze TV. She previously hosted "The News and Why It Matters,"  featuring notable guests such as Glenn Beck, Ben Shapiro, Dave Rubin, Michael Knowles, Candace Owens, Michael Malice, and more. As a conservative commentator, Sara frequently calls out the Democrats for their hypocrisy, the mainstream media for their misinformation, feminists for their toxicity, and also focuses on pro-life issues, culture, gender issues, health care, the Second Amendment, and passing conservative values to the next generation. Sara also appears as a recurring guest on the Megyn Kelly Show, The Sean Spicer Show, Tim Pool, and with Jesse Kelly on The First TV.
